title: AnyPS5: PS5 games as native PC programs
notes: Facts checked 2026-10-09: github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5 (README, docs/user/COMPATIBILITY.md, docs/user/USAGE.md, docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md, releases v0.1.0/v0.1.1 of 2026-09-28; created 2026-08-03; 16,380 stars, +10,243 in GitHub's weekly trending; GPL-2.0) and its progress page boykopovar.github.io/AnyPS5 (system libraries 2,575 of 3,038 known functions = 84.76%; GPU shader instructions 1,166 of 1,166). Compatibility: Dreaming Sarah (PPSA02929), Windows in game/playable, Linux '?', 60 FPS on GTX 1050 Ti / i5-7500, 36 FPS on Intel HD Graphics 620 / i5-7200. The PS5's CPU is AMD Zen 2 (x86-64); --to-intel lowers AMD-only instructions. Narration: ElevenLabs voice 'Brian' via vidIQ. `say` is what the voice reads; `text` is shown and aligned. Edit: the read was cut to 90 s (line 'Of the three thousand functions...' and 'One is a small number. But it's the first.' removed; pauses tightened; tempo 1.054).

lines.text: This tool has one PlayStation 5 game running on a PC. Exactly one.
lines.say: This tool has one PlayStation 5 game running on a PC. Exactly one.

lines.text: And in two months, 16,000 people starred it on GitHub.
lines.say: And in two months, sixteen thousand people starred it on GitHub.

lines.text: Here's why that's a big deal.
lines.say: Here's why that's a big deal.

lines.text: Normally, that takes emulation: software pretending to be the whole console, translating every instruction while you play.
lines.say: Normally, that takes emulation: software pretending to be the whole console, translating every instruction while you play.

lines.text: Inside a PS5 is an AMD processor that speaks your PC's language, so the game's code can run as it is.
lines.say: Inside a PS5 is an AMD processor that speaks your PC's language, so the game's code can run as it is.

lines.text: What's missing is Sony's system software: the libraries every game calls for graphics, sound and controllers.
lines.say: What's missing is Sony's system software: the libraries every game calls for graphics, sound and controllers.

lines.text: So AnyPS5 rewrites the game into an ordinary Windows or Linux program, and reconnects those calls to its own versions of Sony's libraries.
lines.say: So Any PS5 rewrites the game into an ordinary Windows or Linux program, and reconnects those calls to its own versions of Sony's libraries.

lines.text: Graphics too: shaders written for the PS5's AMD chip are recompiled for Vulkan, so ordinary PC graphics cards can draw them.
lines.say: Graphics too: shaders written for the PS5's AMD chip are recompiled for Vulkan, so ordinary PC graphics cards can draw them.

lines.text: Emulation is an interpreter whispering every line. This is translating the book once.
lines.say: Emulation is an interpreter whispering every line. This is translating the book once.

lines.text: The only game on its list so far is Dreaming Sarah, a 2D platformer: 60 frames per second on a GTX 1050 Ti, 36 on a laptop's Intel graphics.
lines.say: The only game on its list so far is Dreaming Sarah, a 2D platformer: sixty frames per second on a G.T.X. ten-fifty T.I., thirty-six on a laptop's Intel graphics.

lines.text: The catch: it's one game, on Windows. Linux is still a question mark.
lines.say: The catch: it's one game, on Windows. Linux is still a question mark.

lines.text: It ships no games, keys or firmware, so you need your own. And only download it from GitHub: fake PS5 emulators are a classic malware trap.
lines.say: It ships no games, keys or firmware, so you need your own. And only download it from GitHub: fake PS5 emulators are a classic malware trap.

lines.text: That's today's tool. There's a new one every day.
lines.say: That's today's tool. There's a new one every day.
